Near end: 'We find that this regulation as well, is properly grounded' - holding is on regulation 46(3) of the broadcasting regulations (vires), not KICA s.46R

Para 13-15: 'In accordance with our recent decision in Evans Nyamari Ayako v R (supra) we translate the life sentence to 30 years' - applies Ayako (E19), no own holding

Para 15-16: 'that wave has since died following the Supreme Court's decision in Republic v Mwangi' - applies SC Mwangi; no own constitutional ruling on 8(2)
